parameters.name: tube_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-34, D-54, kept by D-131 (the same outside sections in welded, galvanized steel box tube): 20 x 40; the 20 mm face carries the skin, so the 40 mm runs through the wall (outer_t = ACP 3 + frame 40)

parameters.name: tube_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: frame depth = outer panel 46 - skin 3 - bond 3 = 40 (D-34)

parameters.name: tube_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the Joints Engineer's gauges for D-131 (PM ruling, 2026-11-01 05:29): 1.2 for a side panel's rails and front stile, for margin against thin tube and weak welds (corner lift 74% on L1 and L2)

parameters.name: corner_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the same: the 40 x 40 members (the back stile, and the upper panel's top member) stay 1.0

parameters.name: stud_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the same: the studs at 0.8 (no rivnut, only the skin's bond line)

parameters.name: plate_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the Joints Engineer's corner detail (2026-11-01 05:05): a 2 mm steel plate welded into each mitre, the members cut back so it fits, centred on the old mitre line

parameters.name: stile_pitch_max
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-11-01 (D-131 sample): the ACP flexes 2 mm or less under a 100 N push at a bay's centre, edges simply supported (make_acp_spans.py), so members about 300 apart; it was 400 (D-16, D-34)

parameters.name: pnl_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: D-49 depth 1495 less the 2.26 gap at the decor back plate (PM ruling on F-008): 1492.74

parameters.name: pnl_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: lower: skeleton side_h (2 sheets per side wall, D-23); upper: from one seam gap above the lower row to the roof datum pod_h, as the skeleton's envelope (equal to side_h at P04 values)

parameters.name: skin_ret
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: back return of the side skin: covers the frame's back end at the corner, where the side skin covers the back panel's edge (D-55; sample drawing D04). V-groove and fold per the ACP maker (HOLD H16)

parameters.name: skin_fold_r
parameters.comment: SOURCE: outside radius of the back return's V-grooved fold: over 2 at the fold (the panel maker's guide 01/2021/HDTC-VD 4.5 and figure 4.5: under 2 cracks the face and voids the warranty); modelled (the Lead's ruling, 2026-11-01)

parameters.name: skin_setback
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: skin edge set back from the frame's top and bottom edges: 0, so the outside reveal equals the 2.26 seam gap (D-23: crisp, aligned reveals; joints register 2.8 leaves the setback to the WALL drawing)

parameters.name: frm_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the frame stops one bond line (bond_t) inside the skin's back return, which is bonded to it as the main face is (the Lead's ruling, 2026-11-01: every skin face that meets a frame is bonded at bond_t, no zero fits)

parameters.name: frm_h
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the frame fills the skeleton envelope height; seam and base gasket gaps are set by the joint register (HOLD)

parameters.name: corner_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the side panel's back member is 40 x 40 x 1.2 (PM ruling on the joints register, item 3, 2026-10-31; register F2, FR-06): the back corner joint needs a 37+ mm overlap for the rivnut and the bolt

parameters.name: stile_n_mid
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: D-131 sample (PM 2026-11-01): 5 studs, placed clear of the bolts (stud_c1 to stud_c5): 4 even studs about 300 apart pass the skin's 2 mm limit but stand 14 and 24 mm from two bolts, under R-J14's 30; R1 two more, at Y -240 and 700, for INTERIOR's ledge brackets (the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's load check), numbered in Y order

parameters.name: top_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: top member height: 20 on a lower panel; 40 x 40 on an upper panel, where the ceiling bolts in (PM ruling R-J3, joints register FR-06)

parameters.name: stile_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: stiles fit between the full-length rails (butt joints)

parameters.name: ceil_bolt_dz
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-CEIL-01 side bolts on the ceiling frame tube's centre: the skeleton's ceil_bolt_z, Z 2374 on P04 (joints register R-J15, FR-07)

parameters.name: fill_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 40 mm PET fill fills the frame depth (D-34; layout study 40 mm)

parameters.name: bolt_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling on F-009: bolt holes 7.0 (0.51 float), position tolerance 0.4 (+-0.2) from the spigot hole, CNC or drill jig (joints register FR-02)

parameters.name: access_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: register FR-03: passes the 18 mm head washer (ISO 7093-1, R-J10), the M6 head and the 5 mm key; holds the grommet retainer (H-02)

parameters.name: bolt_line_y
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: J-WALL-02 bolt line on the back panel's tube centre, Y 824 (joints register R-J15, FR-07)

parameters.name: rivnut_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-163 (the Lead's ruling, 2026-11-01): Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 in a round drilled hole Ø10.00 +0.10/0, inside the maker's 10.00 +0.15/-0.0 (Sherex drawing CAL2-610-4.2 rev B, note 2) so the bolt-hole stack ST-03 stays positive; T06's spin-out test confirms it

parameters.name: spigot_d
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-05: hole for the 8 mm locating spigot H-05

parameters.name: pin_slot_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-169 (Joints, 2026-11-01): the decor block's pin slots 8.5 wide in X

parameters.name: pin_slot_l
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-169: 12 long in Z, along the member; on the bolt line, 100 from each end of the seam edge (the register's spigot rule)

parameters.name: spigot_slot
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-167 (the Lead's ruling, 2026-11-01): the seam gasket is 4.78 (PORON 4701-40's standard), so the side panels' back-end slot for the second spigot grows from 8.5 x 14 to 8.5 x 16, ±4 of travel, the panel held 3.4 out

parameters.name: spigot_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's spigot_inset: spigots 100 from each end of the edge (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J13)

parameters.name: bolt_edge
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's bolt_edge_inset: end bolts 220 in from the panel's ends, evenly spaced, every bolt 30 or more from any stile (PM ruling 2026-10-31, R-J14)

parameters.name: n_side_jnt
parameters.comment: SOURCE: register J-WALL-02, J-FRONT-01: 3 bolts up each side panel

parameters.name: side_jnt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: equal pitch of the 3 bolts up the corner and decor joints

parameters.name: pocket_w
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: register FR-10: fill left out 60 x 60 next to each bolt for the key

parameters.name: corner_z0
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: bottom of the back panel row this side panel meets at the corner (B1/B2 or B3/B4, skeleton P04)

parameters.name: corner_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-WALL-02 bolts run along the back panel's edge: 220, 559.31, 898.61 on its 1118.61 (joints register 2.9)

parameters.name: n_len_bolt
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the skeleton's n_base_bolt (4): the same count on J-WALL-01 and the J-CEIL-01 side edges (register 2.9)

parameters.name: ceil_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: J-CEIL-01 side edge: 4 bolts along the ceiling's 1495 from Y -645 (its front edge), 220 rule, pitch 351.67 on P04; CEILING drills the same (PM ruling 2026-10-31 16:55; joints register 2.9)

parameters.name: len_bolt_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: even pitch of the bolts along the panel

parameters.name: int_stud_d1
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's load check (WALL group): its ledge bracket stud at Y -240 (the ledge's left end) at the P04 size: 402.74 behind the frame's front end (Y -642.74)

parameters.name: int_stud_d2
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's load check (WALL group): its ledge bracket stud at Y 700 (the ledge's right end) at the P04 size: 144 before the frame's back end (Y 844)

parameters.name: stud_c1
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 50 past the 1st bolt: its face 40 clear of it (R-J14)

parameters.name: stud_c2
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: INTERIOR's ledge bracket at Y -240

parameters.name: stud_c3
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 50 before the 2nd bolt (R-J14)

parameters.name: stud_c4
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: midway between the 2nd and 3rd bolts

parameters.name: stud_c5
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 50 past the 3rd bolt (R-J14)

parameters.name: stud_c6
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 50 before the 4th bolt (R-J14)

parameters.name: stud_c7
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: INTERIOR's ledge bracket at Y 700

parameters.name: felt_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: plan VT03-PET 9 mm PET felt; HW-SEL A3; D-31 (the factory's felt)

parameters.name: tray_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: D-37: galvanised steel tray 0.5 mm

parameters.name: tray_h
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): the wall cassettes use the ceiling's tray, returns the full cassette depth (34) turned in as lips that hold the felt, no ribs; settles H09 for the walls

parameters.name: lip_w
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: PM ruling 2026-10-31 (WALL group, option 1): 12 mm lips hold the felt edge

parameters.name: bend_r
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: inside bend radius 1 x t for 0.5 mm DX51D (the sheet metal rule's bend radius is its Thickness); the factory's tooling sets it (guideline 9)

parameters.name: felt_c
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: felt edge clearance inside the returns, as the ceiling cassette

parameters.name: gap_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: air gap between the tray base and the felt (24): the acoustic gap (D-17) and the cable path (D-26)

parameters.name: lin_front_dy
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: Lead ruling 2026-11-01 (F-308, F-309): the right-hand cassettes start at Y -640, 1 mm off DR's inner panel (its room face at Y -641.14, FRONT's measurement; the panel stays), and the service steps unclip R1's and R2's cassettes before that panel comes off; the left-hand ones start at the decor back plate (Y -645)

parameters.name: cass_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: from the cassette's front end (lin_front_dy behind the decor back plate) to past the back cassette's face, closing the inside corner (D-57): 1445 on the left, 1440 on the right

parameters.name: cass_h
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: lower: the panel height; upper: stops lin_gap under the roof frame so it floats (D-57)

parameters.name: clip_zone_h
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: height of each reserved clip zone (H03: no clip named)

parameters.name: clip_zone_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: clip zone centre from the cassette's top and bottom edges (H03)

parameters.name: stopw_od
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: stop washer Ø10.5 x Ø20 x 1.5 (PROPOSED part)

parameters.name: stopw_id
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08

parameters.name: stopw_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-08: rivnut head 0.76 + washer 1.5 = the 2.26 stop (R-J5)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: flange Ø12.45 to 12.95, the largest modelled (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_head_t
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: flange 0.68 to 0.84, its middle; with the 1.5 stop washer the 2.26 stop (R-J5), as before (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_body_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B: knurled body Ø9.91 max (D-163)

parameters.name: rivnut_len
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Sherex CAL2-610-4.2 rev B, note 3: installed length 9.65 max under the flange (14.35 to 15.11 before setting); the bulge inside the tube is not modelled (D-163)

parameters.name: m6_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: M6 threads shown at their 6 mm major diameter (no modelled thread)

parameters.name: spigot_pin_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05: Ø8 stainless pin; the part itself is Joints' 831001 STEP, placed as it is (F-189)

parameters.name: spigot_proud
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-05 and Joints' README: the pin's top 8.00 above the tube face (Z 7.24 above its origin on the rivnut head)

parameters.name: el_trunk_z
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) trunk_z: the cable trunk height in B2-CASS and R1-CASS, above the ledge (about Z 1000), below the R1/R2 joint

parameters.name: el_col_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) col_d; D-61: the air column is 217 x 360

parameters.name: el_y_kit
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) y_kit: the voice kit drop, halfway between the column's back face and the back lining (Y 240.5, D-70)

parameters.name: el_fx_back
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL's y_fx: FX-COL's centre 27 in front of the air column's back face (Y -312 at the P04 size), so it follows the column in an edit

parameters.name: el_y_fx
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: ELECTRICAL's y_fx: Y -312

parameters.name: el_z_fx
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL's z_fx: FX-COL's centre height, Z 1162.5

parameters.name: el_fx_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL's fx_d: Ø32, to pass the trunk's mated plug pair

parameters.name: el_fs_y0
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) FS-CNR: the corner felt slot starts 2 mm behind the back lining's face plane

parameters.name: el_fs_y1
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) FS-CNR: and ends 20 mm behind it, clear of R1-CASS's back lip

parameters.name: el_fs_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) FS-CNR: half the corner felt slot's height (trunk_z +- 60)

parameters.name: el_kit_d
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) kit_d: felt access hole for the kit drop, with a felt plug

parameters.name: el_kit_dz
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: ELECTRICAL P01 (electrical_model.py, PR #64) FA-KIT: the access hole's centre 80 above the trunk

parameters.name: el_tie_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): a Heyco 3904 push-mount cable tie in a Ø6.4 hole through the tray's back sheet; its wings sit behind the sheet, so never in front of a frame member

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y1
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): R1-CASS tie 1 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z)

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y2
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): R1-CASS tie 2 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z)

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y3
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): R1-CASS tie 3 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z)

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y4
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): R1-CASS tie 4 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z)

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y5
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL via the Lead (2026-11-01 11:37 UTC): R1-CASS tie 5 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z)

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y6
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL in WALL's group (2026-11-01, the column route agreed with CEILING): R1-CASS tie 6 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z), moved from -41.5

parameters.name: el_tie_r1_y7
parameters.comment: SOURCE: ELECTRICAL in WALL's group (2026-11-01 17:37 UTC, WALL's ask): R1-CASS tie 7 along the trunk (Z el_trunk_z), moved from -268.4 (the column route) to -150, not -138.0, so its hole's edge keeps 15 from the face of R1's stud at Y -121.8; 162 from FX-COL's centre, inside ELECTRICAL's 150 rule

parameters.name: int_rn_z1
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's fixings (CEILING Engineer's load check, WALL group): each ledge bracket's lower rivnut, Z 815

parameters.name: int_rn_z2
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's fixings (CEILING Engineer's load check, WALL group): each ledge bracket's upper rivnut, Z 1045

parameters.name: int_so_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's fixings (CEILING Engineer's load check, WALL group): INTERIOR's steel stand-off, Ø12, from the stud to 5 proud of the felt

parameters.name: int_clr_d
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the Lead's ruling of 2026-11-01 on INTERIOR's fixings (CEILING Engineer's load check, WALL group): the clearance hole in the tray and the felt, 2 round the stand-off, so the lining floats free of it (D-17)

parameters.name: ledge_t
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): galvanized steel sheet, DX51D+Z (EN 10346), Z100; 1.5 (the Lead's ruling the same day) so each rivet's countersink is machined in the upright with land under it, the heads flush and the rail's hole plain: 0.40 clear of the tray at J-FRAME-01's worst case

parameters.name: ledge_r
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: inside bend radius 1 x t, as the trays (the sheet metal rule's)

parameters.name: ledge_out
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the leg from the rail's room face, under the tray's 34 deep bottom return; its tip 10 short of the lining's room face, out of sight

parameters.name: ledge_up
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the upright reaches 2 under the bottom rail's top face

parameters.name: ledge_pad_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: Joints' pick (WALL group, 2026-11-01): Rogers PORON 4701-40, the 320 kg/m3 grade, 2.36 thick (a standard size), PSA one side, slit 18 wide; the ledge's 7.7 kPa squeezes it about 2%, to about 2.31, so the leg sits 2.31 under the frame's bottom and the cassette's bottom stays level with it (the foam is ±10% thick)

parameters.name: ledge_pad_w
parameters.comment: SOURCE: Joints' pick: the pad slit 18 wide, on the leg's flat past its bend

parameters.name: ledge_front_dy
parameters.comment: CONFIRMED: both sides' ledges start where the right-hand cassettes do (lin_front_dy on R: the Lead's ruling on F-308 and F-309), so L1's and R1's are one part

parameters.name: ledge_end
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): the ledge's ends 5 inside the right-hand cassette's

parameters.name: ledge_len
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: 1430: the right-hand cassette's length less 5 at each end

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the hole for 838012, Ø3.3 in the upright and the rail

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_n
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the Lead's ledge ruling, 2026-11-01 (WALL's sizes, accepted): 6 rivets for the two cassettes' 20.2 kg, about 33 N each

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_e
parameters.comment: ASSUMPTION: the end rivets 40 in from the ledge's ends

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_z
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the rivet line 9 above the frame's bottom: 9.0 from the upright's top edge (2.8 x the Ø3.2 rivet) and the hole's edge 8.2 from the bend

parameters.name: ledge_rivet_pitch
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: even, so the pattern is symmetric and the turned copy (RH) matches: one part

parameters.name: rivet_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): 838012, closed end (D-166), countersunk, aluminium body with a steel mandrel, 3.2 x 8, grip 1.0 to 3.5 for the 1.5 + 1.2 = 2.7; shear 1100 N, tensile 1450 N

parameters.name: rivet_head_d
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the countersunk head Ø5.8 to 6.7, its largest

parameters.name: rivet_csk_angle
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): the head's 120 degrees

parameters.name: rivet_head_t
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the head's cone: 1.01 deep for Ø6.7 at 120 (the standard allows 1.3 at most: a rim at most 0.3 proud still clears the tray by 0.1 at J-FRAME-01's worst case)

parameters.name: ledge_csk_d
parameters.comment: CALCULATION: the upright's machined countersink: Ø6.7 at the head's 120, the head's largest, so every head (Ø5.8 to 6.7) sits flush or under; 0.52 of the 1.5 upright stays under it at the Ø3.3 hole (a third of its thickness)

parameters.name: rivet_len
parameters.comment: SOURCE: joints register H-47, KK2 (Wurth 51452328 and the ISO 15974 table): 8 long overall (its envelope)
